text: DSH 录音卡插件面向使用兼容 BLE 录音卡的用户，可在 Web 客户端连接 DSH Host 并通过 Agent 工具操作设备。它注册扫描、连接、状态查询、录音控制、录音列表、音频导入和转写工具，并提供会话中的连接卡片。导入的 WAV 会保存到 Host 本地归档，可选调用 DSH speechToText 生成 Markdown 转写并按音频指纹复用结果。适合将实体录音卡中的会议或语音带入 DSH 工作流；需要录音卡、Host 蓝牙和 Python 环境，云端 Doubao 转写为可选项。

Use BLE recorder cards with DSH. Web and Agent tools scan, connect, inspect recordings, control recording, and import WAV audio. Optional DSH speechToText creates Markdown transcripts; files are archived on the Host. Requires recorder hardware, Host Bluetooth, and Python.
想把 BLE 录音卡里的会议音频导入 DSH。
我想在 DSH 里扫描并连接附近的录音卡。
能不能查看录音卡的电量和固件状态？
帮我列出录音设备上保存的录音文件。
我想把录音转成文字并保存为 Markdown。
怎样在 DSH 中开始或暂停录音卡上的录音？
I want to import a meeting recording from my BLE recorder into DSH.
Can DSH scan for my recorder and show its battery status?
扫描并连接兼容的 BLE 录音卡：可扫描设备、由用户选择目标并保持 Host 连接，随后读取设备状态或录音列表。
导入录音卡中的单个 WAV 文件：按录音列表中的准确文件名选择，也可省略名称导入首个文件；导入后将音频存入 Host 归档目录。
将已导入的 WAV 转成文字：使用 DSH speechToText，缺少该服务时可回退到 Doubao，并把转写整理为带音频指纹的 Markdown 归档。
管理录音卡录制操作：通过 Agent 工具读取状态或请求开始、暂停、继续和保存录音，并返回操作结果。
录音转写在 DSH speechToText 服务缺失时会使用 Doubao 云端 ASR；该回退会上传音频，需配置相应凭据。

dsh-recorder-card README · dsh-recorder-card：[中文](README.zh.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

**Bring recordings from a physical recorder card into DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — select a recording in conversation, import it over BLE, and optionally transcribe and archive it.

dsh-recorder-card README · dsh-recorder-card：**You need a compatible physical BLE recorder card**, plus Python 3.11+ and Bluetooth access on the machine running DSH Host. A remote Host uses its own Bluetooth hardware; card and firmware compatibility must be verified.

dsh-recorder-card README · dsh-recorder-card：> **Third-party development preview.** Named import and transfer diagnostics are available; version 0.6.0 adds slow-link tolerance, cleanup recovery fixes and optional budget preflight. A short test recording has passed real DSH import and audio checks; local SenseVoice transcription and archive reuse have separate Host evidence. Non-first and long-recording imports, interrupted-transfer recovery and remote recording controls remain incompletely verified. The 0.6.0 additions have offline tests and user-confirmed QA, with hardware validation pending. [Install](#installation-and-first-use) · [Verification status](#current-status) · [Release record](RELEASE.md)

dsh-recorder-card README · Purpose：For people who already use a recorder card for meetings, interviews or voice notes: carry those recordings into a DSH workflow after recording. Capture uses the card; this workflow does not require recording through the computer microphone.

The implementation follows the [upstream AI recorder card protocol](https://github.com/nextproto1024/ai-recorder-card-open-protocol). Support for a particular card or firmware must be verified; a shared product name alone does not establish compatibility.
dsh-recorder-card README · Purpose：**Audio path:** recorder card → BLE → bundled Python CLI on DSH Host → local audio → optional transcript and fingerprint-linked Markdown archive.

dsh-recorder-card README · Purpose：- Click one icon to connect, then use conversation to list recordings and select an exact on-card filename.
- Import into a local directory with PCM completeness checks and no overwriting of existing audio; keep the recording on the card.
- Request transcription separately. Prefer a prepared DSH recognizer; cloud fallback uploads audio and requires explicit transcription intent.

dsh-recorder-card README · Purpose：The connection icon and eight Agent tools share a persistent Host service, without Web Bluetooth or a separate upstream checkout. See [architecture](docs/architecture.md) for execution boundaries and [acceptance evidence](docs/import-recovery.md) for what has actually been tested.

dsh-recorder-card README · Purpose：If connection cleanup fails, the icon retains an unconfirmed-release warning. Pending device work fails before accessing BLE; inspect the card before explicitly retrying. A disconnected process alone is not proof of successful device cleanup.

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：These instructions target 0.4.0 or later. Versions 0.3.x use the previous settings card; older releases may require an external checkout. Install with:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-recorder-card
python -m pip install bleak requests
```

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：The Host needs Python 3.11+, Bluetooth hardware and permission. The pinned Python CLI is bundled: no upstream clone or `repoRoot` setting is needed. If `python` is not on the DSH PATH, configure the plugin's `python` field with the absolute path of the same interpreter.

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：1. Wake the card and disconnect other Bluetooth clients. Click the recorder icon or ask the Agent to call `recorder_connect`. A unique device connects and is remembered automatically; multiple candidates require your choice.
2. Ask in the conversation to list recordings or disconnect. Use the icon's context menu to switch devices, or call `recorder_connect` with an empty address to scan afresh. Advanced `deviceAddress` configuration remains a fallback. npm 0.3.1 users still use the original card's device-address input.
3. Call `recorder_list` and select an authorized recording. Version 0.4.0 imports only the first file; 0.5.0 supports `recorder_import({ "filename": "exact name from list" })`. Omit `filename` for the first file; transcription defaults off. For multiple selected recordings, call sequentially and stop on transfer errors; no external CLI is needed.
4. Audio defaults to `~/.dsh-recorder-card/archive/audio/` on the Host; use the absolute path returned by the tool. Optional transcription needs a prepared DSH recognizer, or credentials for Doubao cloud ASR. Scanning and importing need no ASR credentials.

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：When DSH/pnpm sets `minimumReleaseAge=1440`, a new release may be unavailable for its first 24 hours. Wait for the release to mature; do not disable that policy.

Before upgrading, back up the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and `package.json`; compare custom settings afterward and verify the chosen model and speech service. Reported configuration loss has not been reproduced and is not established as expected upgrade behavior. See [upgrade checks](docs/import-recovery.md#profile-upgrade).

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：New error codes distinguish `RECORDER_DEVICE_DISCONNECTED` (an observed disconnect) from `RECORDER_TRANSFER_INTERRUPTED` (incomplete transfer without confirmed disconnection). Inspect the device, reconnect, then explicitly retry that file from the beginning. Byte resume and automatic reconnection are not implemented. Resolve unconfirmed cleanup first; if audio was imported but transcription failed, retry transcription only.

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：Version 0.5.0 also adds transfer diagnostics: phase timings, received frame/byte counts and the age of the last snapshot on interruption. Host saves the latest diagnostic to `dataDir/recorder-diagnostics.json`, without audio, filenames or device identifiers. These counters are not a completion percentage or proof of audio integrity; there is no UI progress stream. See [diagnostic fields and limits](docs/import-recovery.md#transfer-diagnostics). This addition has offline verification only.

dsh-recorder-card README · Installation and first use：Install Python dependencies once using the same interpreter configured in the plugin. Alternatively, from the installed plugin directory run `python -m pip install -r vendor/upstream/tools/requirements.txt`. Missing-dependency errors name the active interpreter and installation command. From the installed plugin directory, `python -B runtime/recorder_cli.py --check-deps` checks setup without Bluetooth access. See the [distribution validation record](docs/distribution-validation.md) for tested environments and remaining acceptance.

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：“Implemented” means code exists, not that it has passed DSH or hardware testing. The recorded Host baseline is DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows, using an isolated headless profile.

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：| Capability | Implementation | Verification / remaining work |
|---|---|---|
| Bundle manifest and Skill provider | Implemented | M1 passed in an isolated DSH profile: loading, Skill access, disable/re-enable and child cleanup |
| Single connection icon and conversation guidance | Implemented in 0.4.0 | Native desktop connection color, guidance submission and draft preservation pass; model reply, physical drops and multiple physical cards remain pending |
| Import through conversation | First-file and exact list-name import released in 0.5.0 | Real DSH Agent named import and retained connection pass; test file was first in list, so non-first selection and interruption recovery remain pending |
| Browser direct BLE | Retired from the shipped Client | Previous implementation retained only as a regression fixture |
| Host Python CLI calls | Pinned-source adapter and process manager | Internal listing hardware smoke test and local queue/cancellation tests pass; DSH lifecycle verified; hardware tool acceptance pending, pinned CLI sources now bundled; no separate clone required |
| `recorder_*` Agent device tools | Eight tools registered, typed

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：See [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) for acceptance criteria. A [partial standalone CLI hardware run](docs/cli-validation.md) verified scan/status/list responses and a single-file transfer with complete WAV decoding; the user confirmed correct playback/content, while recording controls and remaining acceptance cases are pending. A later internal Host listing smoke test passed. Remote recording start remained unacknowledged; a physical-button recording appeared in the confirmed list. Full DSH tool acceptance remains pending.

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：Import now preserves same-name audio, publishes complete staged files under a unique name when needed, and returns separate import/transcription states. Publication requires verified RIFF/WAVE PCM structure; truncated or unsupported audio remains unconfirmed. Transcription failure or unconfirmed connection cleanup returns `status: partial` with independent stage details; this is not full workflow success. See the [runtime contract](skill/references/runtime.md#safe-import-and-separate-transcription-results).

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：Local regressions cover the actual official Client/Host Gateways over an in-process JSON carrier, card hooks, cancellation, partial imports, and service sharing with Agent tools. Legacy browser BLE tests remain as historical regressions. Run `npm test`; see [local checks](CONTRIBUTING.md#local-checks-without-hardware) for limits.

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：Click the recorder icon to reconnect the saved card, or scan on first use. One discovered card connects automatically; multiple cards require a choice in the conversation. Gray means disconnected, pulsing means connecting, and green means Host-confirmed BLE connection. Click again while connecting to cancel. Connection success sends a guidance request to the current conversation without changing the composer draft. Use conversation commands for listing, first-file import and optional transcription. Right-click or Shift+F10 exposes disconnect and switch-device actions. No settings form expands in the toolbar. Cloud transcription fallback uploads audio and requires explicit transcription intent.

dsh-recorder-card README · Current status：Version 0.6.0 adds optional import budget preflight: pass `preflight: { expectedBytes, bytesPerSecond }` with known exported-size and reference-rate estimates. An over-budget estimate rejects before import and suggests `cliTimeoutMs`; omitting it preserves existing behavior. Card-list size is not exported WAV size, and passing does not guarantee completion. See [usage and limits](skill/references/runtime.md#import-budget-preflight). QA has passed; hardware validation remains pending.

dsh-recorder-card README · Development requirements：**Slow-link fixes in 0.6.0:** `cliTimeoutMs` reaches both Python paths; imports adapt idle tolerance within 12–20 seconds, record frame-interval statistics and check local disconnect plus bounded re-advertising after interrupted transfers. For a 10-minute Python operation budget, configure `cliTimeoutMs: 610000` (10 seconds reserved for startup/cleanup). These changes have offline coverage only, do not speed up BLE, and do not add automatic batch recovery or byte resume. See [scope and remaining evidence](docs/import-recovery.md#slow-link-fixes).

dsh-recorder-card README · Development requirements：- A DSH environment exposing plugin development capabilities. The recorded baseline is Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; other versions/profiles need verification.
- For the optional icon: DSH Client Gateway, sessions/conversation services and the conversation input-left Slot. Bluetooth hardware and permission are required on the Host.
- Node.js for syntax checks; the minimum version remains to be established with the target DSH runtime.
- For the Host CLI main path: Python 3.11+ and Bleak/requests. Pinned scripts and requirements are shipped under `vendor/upstream/tools/`.

dsh-recorder-card README · First development check：1. Follow the [local checks](CONTRIBUTING.md). Prepare Python/Bleak, check the bundled CLI, and enable Bluetooth access on the intended Host machine.
2. Start M2a independently: scan, read status/list, and import/play one non-personal test recording, then complete recording controls and failure scenarios. DSH loading is not a prerequisite.
3. Reproduce [M1 Host validation](docs/dsh-integration.md) on the target environment. The isolated Windows baseline passed; card rendering remains a separate optional check.
4. With M1 loading and the relevant M2a device baseline, follow M2b → M3 → M4 for tools, import and transcription. Track recording-control compatibility separately while advancing the existing-recording workflow. Record implementation, offline and hardware results separately; standalone CLI success does not establish a working plugin workflow.

dsh-recorder-card README · Architecture：| Component | File | Current role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | [index.js](index.js) | Skill/tools, shared injectable recorder Service and Remote controller |
| Agent tools | [runtime/tools.js](runtime/tools.js) | Six CLI-backed tools; process completion is separate from device/file verification |
| Host process manager | [runtime/host-cli.js](runtime/host-cli.js) | Shared device queue, argument checks, deadlines, cancellation and disposal; live DSH validation pending |
| CLI adapter | [runtime/recorder_cli.py](runtime/recorder_cli.py) | External source validation, list/record confirmations, per-process timeouts and connection cleanup |
| Client | [client.js](client.js) | React card calling Host Remote; no browser BLE ownership |
| Skill | [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md) | Capability checks, resource locations, and device constraints |
| Protocol | [vendor/recorder-protocol.js](vendor/recorder-protocol.js) | CRC, frames, parsers, and command primitives |
| Loader | [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) | Plugin loader entry |
dsh-recorder-card README · Architecture：See [architecture and open decisions](docs/architecture.md) for BLE ownership, bundled CLI configuration, and planned data flow.

dsh-recorder-card README · Transcription and archives：Fixes in 0.3.1: recheck current audio bytes before returning a cached result. Moving/copying identical audio reuses the text in a separate archive with the current audio path/title, preserving old archives. Inferred timing remains tied to the original source, recorded in `transcription_source_audio` / `recorded_at_source_audio`; these are historical provenance, not current audio links.

dsh-recorder-card README · Transcription and archives：`transcriptionProvider` defaults to `dsh`, using the Host's `speechToText` service and selected recognizer, not necessarily a DeepSeek cloud API. Check three conditions separately: the Host can load the packages, the active profile mounts the service and recognizer, and the selected recognizer is ready. Installing packages alone does not satisfy the latter two conditions.

dsh-recorder-card README · Transcription and archives：The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text` package provides the service. The verified local recognizer comes from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice` and requires configuration and prepared models. These packages are not shipped with this plugin but may be included in DSH; install compatible versions separately only when the Host lacks them. The inspected Windows DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` includes these packages, but its default `dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` bundles do not reference them. Our real test mounted them through an additional profile patch; see [M4 validation](docs/transcription-validation.md). Check other versions separately. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-api-speech-to-text` provides the official speech Remote interface; configure it when needed by the corresponding speech UI. It is not a hard dependency of this plugin's direct transcription calls.

dsh-recorder-card README · Transcription and archives：Only an absent `speechToText` service falls back to bundled Doubao cloud ASR; an unregistered recognizer, unprepared models, recognition failures or cancellation in an existing service never trigger fallback. Explicit `doubao` is also supported: it uploads audio and needs Host environment or `dataDir/.env` credentials. OpenAI and a standalone `local` provider remain future work.

dsh-recorder-card README · Transcription and archives：Success includes `provider`, `recognizer`, the Markdown `path`, `audioSha256` and `reused`. Failure retains audio for a separate `recorder_transcribe` retry. DSH returns plain text without segment timestamps or diarization; the archive labels filename-derived start time (unknown timezone) and default speaker “说话人1” as inferred values.

dsh-recorder-card README · Data layout：```text
archive/audio/    # imported audio
archive/corpus/   # transcript Markdown
```

dsh-recorder-card README · Data layout：Archives use `audio_sha256`, provider, recognizer and language for reuse, with body integrity checked before reuse. Empty results are rejected; same-name different audio cannot reuse the wrong result. `force: true` creates a new archive and preserves existing files. Relative output and transcription input paths resolve under `dataDir`, defaulting to `~/.dsh-recorder-card` on the Host. `repoRoot` only selects CLI source. Device cache and optional `.env` also live in the data directory, not the installed package. Transcription currently accepts complete canonical 44-byte-header, 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV up to 64 MiB; recognizers may impose smaller limits. No automatic splitting or resampling is performed.
dsh-recorder-card README · Data layout：Keep audio, transcripts, device addresses, and credentials out of version control. See [.gitignore](.gitignore); check external checkouts' ignore rules too.

dsh-recorder-card README · Contributing：For AI-assisted collaboration, start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and the [developer](docs/roles/open-source-developer.md) or [QA](docs/roles/qa.md) role. These documents are shared across tools; `.cursor/rules/` is an optional Cursor adapter. See [role setup](CONTRIBUTING.md#development-and-qa-roles) for explicit loading instructions when a tool does not discover the entry point automatically.

dsh-recorder-card README · Contributing：Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Keep this README and [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) aligned when behavior or status changes. Completed changes belong in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md); future work belongs in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md).
